description: Map of every test of the reference sandbox suite (source/sandbox.test.js.txt, a verbatim snapshot) to where its assertions are verified in the factory. Data only, not executable tests. 'portable' cases run under npm test (ralph/sandbox.test.js) with the processes replaced at the child_process boundary. 'integration' cases need a real Docker engine: `integration` names the executable tests of the Docker integration (test/integration/ralph-sandbox.test.js, `npm run test:ralph:sandbox`). The status 'integration-mapped' records that executable coverage exists, never that a run passed: the result of a run is proven only by the CI job "Ralph sandbox integration". ralph/sandbox-cases.test.js keeps the map honest.

destinations.integration: test/integration/ralph-sandbox.test.js, task #46 (real Docker, not part of npm test)
destinations.both: the argument-building part is portable (#18), the part that needs a real container is in the Docker integration (#46)

cases.source: sandbox does not see operator HOME marker
assertions: a marker file in the operator HOME is not visible through $HOME inside the container
the host path of the marker does not exist inside the container
a find over the container filesystem does not find the marker

cases.source: rejects sandbox config mounting operator home
assertions: buildRunArgs rejects runDir equal to the home, runDir inside the home, sessionsDir ~/.claude
HOME or USERPROFILE of the given env define the home as well
isInsideHome is true for the home and for ~/.ssh

cases.source: accepts sandbox config mounting only run dir
assertions: mounts are exactly the clone, its .git read-only and the sessions dir, in this order, for readOnlyGit
only the clone is mounted without sessionsDir; the clone and the sessions dir with it
no -v, --volume, --tmpfs or --volumes-from

cases.source: sandbox returns empty git credentials
assertions: a credential helper works on the controller side
inside the sandbox `git credential fill` returns no password and fails
the sandbox HOME has no .ssh content

cases.source: sandbox has no operator gh config
assertions: $HOME/.config/gh and its hosts.yml do not exist in the container

cases.source: sandbox blocks request to foreign host
assertions: through the real proxy a CONNECT to a foreign name and to an IP gets 403
a direct connection to an IP and to a name does not connect from the proxied network
cases.integration: test/integration/ralph-sandbox.test.js "enforces proxy allowlist without direct egress"; "fails when controlled service is not reachable"

cases.source: gate sandbox has no network
assertions: with network none a direct connection to an IP and to a name does not connect
the only network interface is lo
cases.integration: test/integration/ralph-sandbox.test.js "isolates real gate network and git directory"

cases.source: proxy policy allows allowlisted host
assertions: CONNECT:443 to each allowlisted host is allowed, also in upper case
parseAuthority parses host:443

cases.source: proxy policy rejects non-CONNECT and non-443
assertions: GET, POST, PUT, lower-case connect and an empty method are refused
ports 80, 22, 8443, 4430, 0 and undefined are refused
parseAuthority returns null for a bare host and for a URL

cases.source: proxy policy rejects subdomain of allowlisted host
assertions: a subdomain, a deeper subdomain, the host as a prefix of another domain, a look-alike name and an IP are refused

cases.source: rejects allowlist entry that is not a host name
assertions: scheme, port, path, IPv4, IPv6, empty, number, null, wildcard, single label and leading dash are rejected
an empty list and a string instead of a list are rejected
a valid entry is kept
cases.portable: ralph/sandbox.test.js "rejects malformed allowlist, node and claude versions"

cases.source: rejects unpinned claude-code version
assertions: ranges, x-ranges, short versions, latest, next, pre-release, build metadata, empty and numbers are rejected
an exact X.Y.Z is accepted
cases.portable: ralph/sandbox.test.js "rejects malformed allowlist, node and claude versions"

cases.source: builds image from controller repo with pinned versions
assertions: the build command is `build`, the last argument is the sandbox directory with a Dockerfile
-t image, NODE_VERSION, CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION and the named context `ralph` are given
cases.portable: ralph/sandbox.test.js "builds image from installed package assets"
cases.status: ported (the files are the installed package's, not the controller checkout's)

cases.source: files written in sandbox are owned by controller user
assertions: a file written in the bind mount belongs to the host user (POSIX)
cases.integration: test/integration/ralph-sandbox.test.js "preserves ownership and external session journals"

cases.source: git works inside sandbox on run dir
assertions: git status and git diff work in the mounted clone with another owner
no 'dubious ownership' error
cases.integration: test/integration/ralph-sandbox.test.js "preserves ownership and external session journals"

cases.source: agent session journals persist after container exit
assertions: after a normal run and after a timeout the session journal is in the sessions dir on the host
a timed-out run reports 'timed out'
cases.integration: test/integration/ralph-sandbox.test.js "preserves ownership and external session journals"; "stops timed out steps and preserves journals"

cases.source: session journals stay outside run dir clone
assertions: the journal is in the sessions dir, outside the clone
git status of the clone is clean after the run
cases.integration: test/integration/ralph-sandbox.test.js "preserves ownership and external session journals"; "stops timed out steps and preserves journals"

cases.source: container is labelled with run id
assertions: run arguments carry the run label and the managed label with the root key
a started container is found by its run label
cases.integration: test/integration/ralph-sandbox.test.js "labels real containers with consumer and run"
cases.status: ported for the run arguments and labels; integration-mapped for a running container found by its labels

cases.source: sandbox tests do not skip when runtime is missing
assertions: assertAvailable throws 'Docker is not available' for a missing runtime
the integration file has no skip markers and fails in before() without a runtime
cases.integration: test/integration/ralph-sandbox.test.js "fails explicitly when integration prerequisites are missing"; "rejects failed empty or skipped integration results"
cases.status: ported for assertAvailable and the absence of a host fallback; integration-mapped for the no-skip guard of the integration run

cases.source: home check treats dotted names inside home as inside and follows links into home
assertions: a name starting with two dots inside the home is inside; the parent of the home is not
a link (junction on Windows) whose target is in the home is inside, also with a child path
mounting a path through such a link is refused; a directory outside the home is outside
cases.status: ported (with a controlled HOME and a target directory inside it); also "rejects invalid or home located runs root"

cases.source: workdir outside the run dir is rejected
assertions: '../workspace-other', '../workspaces', '..' and '../../etc' are rejected as escaping the run dir
'', '.', 'apps/api' and a Windows-style 'apps\\web' are accepted
cases.portable: ralph/sandbox.test.js "preserves mount and workdir boundaries" and "rejects unsafe mount specifications"

cases.source: proxy address goes to the container only, not to the docker CLI env
assertions: HTTPS_PROXY=<proxy url> is a container argument
the secret is passed as -e NAME and its value never appears in argv
cases.portable: ralph/sandbox.test.js "preserves secret and proxy environment boundaries"
cases.status: ported (also checks the env given to the mocked Docker CLI)

cases.source: read-only git mount keeps the clone writable but .git unwritable
assertions: inside the container the working tree is writable
writing a hook or the config under .git fails and nothing appears on the host
cases.integration: test/integration/ralph-sandbox.test.js "enforces agent and git filesystem boundaries"; "isolates real gate network and git directory"

cases.source: a sandbox step that exceeds its time limit is stopped
assertions: the step returns a non-zero status and an error describing the timeout, within the limit
no container with the run label is left
cases.portable: ralph/sandbox.test.js "cleans up owned resources after failure"
cases.integration: test/integration/ralph-sandbox.test.js "stops timed out steps and preserves journals"
cases.status: ported with a replaced Docker CLI; integration-mapped for the real stop of a sleeping container

cases.source: install env may not override proxy or Docker settings
assertions: HTTPS_PROXY, https_proxy, NO_PROXY, ALL_PROXY, DOCKER_*, GIT_*, GCM_*, GH_*, HOME and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR are rejected with 'installEnv may not set'
an ordinary variable is kept
cases.portable: ralph/sandbox.test.js "rejects reserved env name in profile"

cases.source: read-only git mount needs the clone own .git directory
assertions: without a .git directory buildRunArgs is rejected with 'not a real directory'
with a real .git the readonly mount argument is present
cases.status: ported (also a .git file and a .git link are rejected)
